title: Week 21
subtitle: The glucose test is coming up. It is a screening, and there is a way to make it less unpleasant.

baby.size: About the size of a carrot
baby.development: The baby is swallowing amniotic fluid and the digestive system is practising. Eyebrows and eyelids are fully formed. Sleep and wake cycles are starting.

you.body: Your uterus is above your belly button now. You may have a stronger appetite, more heartburn, and a linea nigra. Movement should be getting more noticeable.
you.mind: The middle stretch can feel like a lull. It is a good time to do the planning that is hard to do later, and to rest without guilt.

coreActions.title: Book your glucose test
coreActions.why: Gestational diabetes usually has no symptoms, and it is treatable. The test happens between 24 and 28 weeks, and the window is not flexible.
coreActions.detail: You drink a sweet drink, wait an hour, and have a blood draw. Do not fast unless they tell you to. Ask whether they use the one-hour or two-hour version. If the result is high, the next step is a three-hour test, not a diagnosis.

options.label: The one-hour test
options.detail: The usual first step. No fasting at most practices.

options.label: The two-hour test
options.detail: Some practices start here. You fast beforehand.

coreActions.skipIf: Your glucose test is already booked, or you have already had it.

coreActions.title: Know how to make the glucose test easier
coreActions.why: The drink is cold and sweet and some people feel sick after it. A few small things make the hour pass better.
coreActions.detail: Ask for the drink chilled and drink it slowly. Bring something to do for an hour — you usually cannot leave. Bring water and a snack for after the blood draw. If you feel faint, tell the staff; it is common and they will lie you down.

options.label: Bring a book or headphones
options.detail: An hour is longer than it sounds.

options.label: Bring a snack for after
options.detail: Especially if you fasted. Protein is better than sugar.

coreActions.skipIf: You have already had the test.

coreActions.title: Learn how to check movement
coreActions.why: From about 28 weeks, a change in movement is the main thing you can notice at home. Knowing your baby's pattern is more useful than counting to a number.
coreActions.detail: There is no single correct count. The useful skill is knowing what is usual for your baby, and calling the same day if it changes. Do not use a home Doppler to reassure yourself — they are hard to use correctly and can give false comfort.

options.label: Learn your baby's pattern
options.detail: Pick a time of day when the baby is usually active and notice it.

options.label: Use a counting app
options.detail: Helpful for some, anxiety-inducing for others. Either is fine.

coreActions.skipIf: You already know your baby's pattern well.

alsoKnow.title: Gestational diabetes is not caused by what you ate
alsoKnow.body: The placenta makes hormones that work against insulin. It happens in about 1 in 10 pregnancies, often in people with none of the usual risk factors. It is managed, and it usually goes away after birth.

alsoKnow.title: Ask about your iron again around now
alsoKnow.body: Many practices recheck hemoglobin in the second half. Low iron is common and easy to treat, and it explains a lot of fatigue.

alsoKnow.title: The urge to organize is real and can wait
alsoKnow.body: Nesting is common. Do the small things now and leave the big projects. You will have less energy, not more, in the third trimester.

redFlags.text: A clear change in your baby's usual movement
A severe headache that will not go, or blurred vision
Bleeding that fills a pad, or bleeding with pain

appointments.label: Glucose screening test
appointments.note: Book it now. Ask whether to fast.
